name: koalafix-connect
description: One memory for every AI tool on your team. Facts show who checked them and when.

plugins.name: koalafix-auto
plugins.description: One memory for every AI tool on your team: KoalaFix's tools and skill in Claude chat, Cowork and Claude Code, made automatic by hooks in Claude Code and Cowork (the team brief at session start, recall on each prompt, a warning before editing a file a teammate has checked in on, work in progress started and closed for you, one browser sign-in). Chat runs no hooks. The hooks send each prompt (keys and tokens taken out, never logged) and the paths of files it names or the session edits to your KoalaFix server; teammates see your project, branch and those paths. The hooks need Node.js 22 or later.
